_README: Machine-readable registry of job-data sources, for sweeps to read instead of
rediscovering which APIs are worth calling.
TWO THINGS TO DO BEFORE YOUR FIRST SWEEP:
1. Set have_key to true for each API you have actually registered for, and put
the key in .env (gitignored). Every entry ships have_key:false — a sweep
should skip a source rather than fail on a missing key.
2. Replace ats_verified with the boards YOU care about, and re-verify. Slugs go
stale: companies migrate ATS, get acquired, or close their public board.
Anything unverified for a few months should be treated as unknown.
trust: 3 = full mirrored posting text, safe to rate from. 2 = partial or
aggregated, verify against the source posting. 1 = discovery only, never rate
or present from this alone.
ATS endpoints (no key, JSON, far better signal than any aggregator):
Greenhouse  https://boards-api.greenhouse.io/v1/boards/<slug>/jobs
Lever       https://api.lever.co/v0/postings/<slug>?mode=json
Ashby       https://api.ashbyhq.com/posting-api/job-board/<slug>
Find a slug from the careers-page URL, then confirm it returns JSON before
recording it here.

adzuna.note: CA+US via --country; full mirrored posting text; good primary aggregator

jooble.note: discovery-only, snippet text, noisy; never accept a jooble-only hit

jsearch.note: RapidAPI, small free tier; Google Jobs aggregate incl. ZipRecruiter/Indeed/LinkedIn; set RAPIDAPI_KEY in .env

hn.note: HN Who's-Hiring via Algolia (author whoishiring); unstructured, verify hard; keyless
